This policy explains how your information is collected, used and protected when you visit and shop on the www.voltekno.com website (the "Site"). For detailed information on how your personal data is processed, please refer to the Personal Data Protection Notice (KVKK).
1. Information We Collect
Your name, email address, phone number, address and billing details that you provide in membership, order and contact forms;
Order history, cart and request information;
IP address, browser/device information and cookie data relating to your use of the Site.
2. Payment Security

Payments on the Site are processed through the infrastructure of banks and payment institutions licensed by the Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency (BDDK), using 256-bit SSL encryption and 3D Secure. Your credit card details are neither seen nor stored by our Company.
3. How We Use Your Information

Your information is used to process and deliver your orders, issue invoices, provide after-sales support, fulfill legal obligations, keep the Site secure and, if you have given your consent, inform you about campaigns. Your information is not sold or rented to any third parties other than those listed in the Personal Data Protection Notice (KVKK).
4. Cookie Policy
4.1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files that are saved to your device through your browser when you visit the Site. They allow the Site to function properly, remember your preferences and improve your experience.
4.2. Types of Cookies We Use

Strictly Necessary Cookies: Enable the Site's core functions, such as signing in, the shopping cart, the checkout step and security. Legal Basis: Performance of a contract and legitimate interest (explicit consent not required)
Functional Cookies: Remember your language, region and similar preferences. Legal Basis: Explicit consent
Analytics / Performance Cookies: Help us improve the Site by analyzing visitor numbers, page views and Site usage. Legal Basis: Explicit consent
Marketing / Targeting Cookies: Allow advertisements and campaigns tailored to your interests to be shown to you. Legal Basis: Explicit consent
4.3. Managing Your Cookie Preferences
Cookies other than strictly necessary cookies are used only with your consent. You can change your preference at any time and delete or block cookies through your browser settings:
Google Chrome: Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies and other site data
Mozilla Firefox: Settings > Privacy & Security > Cookies and Site Data
Safari: Preferences > Privacy > Manage Website Data
Microsoft Edge: Settings > Cookies and site permissions
If strictly necessary cookies are blocked, some parts of the Site (cart, checkout, membership) may not work properly.
4.4. Third-Party Cookies

Cookies belonging to our e-commerce infrastructure provider and, if you have given your consent, to analytics and advertising service providers (e.g., Google, Meta) may be used on the Site. The use of these cookies is subject to the privacy policies of the respective providers.
5. Your Rights

To exercise your rights under Article 11 of the KVKK, you may contact us at info@voltekno.com or at our registered electronic mail (KEP) address afetteknoloji@hs01.kep.tr. Further details are provided in the Personal Data Protection Notice (KVKK).
6. Changes
This policy may be updated when necessary. The current version is always published on the Site and takes effect from the date of publication.
